import sys
import math
import itertools

MOD = 1000000007
INV = 570000004

n = int(sys.stdin.readline())

p = [[0]*6 for _ in range(6)]
for i in range(n):
    row = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    for j in range(n):
        p[i][j] = (row[j] * INV) % MOD

for i in range(6):
    for j in range(n, 6):
        if i == j:
            p[i][j] = 1
        else:
            p[i][j] = 0
            p[j][i] = 0

permsA = []
permsB = []

aah = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
t = 0
for aah in itertools.permutations(aah):
    if aah[0] < aah[1] < aah[2] and aah[3] < aah[4] < aah[5]:
        permsA.append([aah[0], aah[1], aah[2]])
        permsB.append([aah[3], aah[4], aah[5]])
        t += 1

size_mask = 1 << 18
bmA = [0] * size_mask
bmB = [0] * size_mask
f = [0] * size_mask

for i in range(size_mask):
    prob1 = 1
    prob2 = 1
    bm1 = 0
    bm2 = 0
    for j in range(6):
        for k in range(3):
            res = j * 3 + k
            if (1 << res) & i:
                prob1 = (prob1 * p[j][k]) % MOD
                prob2 = (prob2 * p[j][k + 3]) % MOD
            else:
                prob1 = (prob1 * (1 + MOD - p[j][k])) % MOD
                prob2 = (prob2 * (1 + MOD - p[j][k + 3])) % MOD
    for ot in range(20):
        ord = [0, 1, 2]
        ok = False
        for perm in itertools.permutations(ord):
            ok2 = True
            for j in range(3):
                val = permsA[ot][perm[j]]
                loc = val * 3 + j
                if not ((1 << loc) & i):
                    ok2 = False
                    break
            if ok2:
                ok = True
                break
        if ok:
            bm1 ^= (1 << ot)
    for ot in range(20):
        ord = [0, 1, 2]
        ok = False
        for perm in itertools.permutations(ord):
            ok2 = True
            for j in range(3):
                val = permsB[ot][perm[j]]
                loc = val * 3 + j
                if not ((1 << loc) & i):
                    ok2 = False
                    break
            if ok2:
                ok = True
                break
        if ok:
            bm2 ^= (1 << ot)
    bmA[bm1] = (bmA[bm1] + prob1) % MOD
    bmB[bm2] = (bmB[bm2] + prob2) % MOD

for i in range(size_mask):
    f[i] = bmA[i]

for i in range(20):
    for mask in range(size_mask):
        if mask & (1 << i):
            f[mask] = (f[mask] + f[mask ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD

sm = 0
full_mask = (1 << 20) - 1
for i in range(size_mask):
    sm += (bmB[i] * f[full_mask ^ i]) % MOD
    sm %= MOD

print((1 + MOD - sm) % MOD)
